Maria (CSM): hey team — Acme sent back the DPA + vendor questionnaire. quick sync: top blockers i see are KMS/BYOK wording, data residency language for embeddings, and a SOC2 evidence bundle for 3 controls. who can own the evidence collation? @priya?
Priya (Solutions Eng): i can take the evidence pack. i'll pull system description, control matrices, change mgmt logs and access review exports. ETA eod thu. need list of exact filenames/legal labels we should use.
Lauren (AE): heads up — i promised them a short playbook/checklist to speed review. can we make a 1‑pager they can pass to legal? i'll send to them once we confirm owners.
Ajay (Security Eng): i'll own KMS/BYOK + key provenance. q: are they asking for AWS KMS specifically? also need to confirm our rotation policy and whether non-prod keys are allowed. short answers: rotation = 90d, non-prod keys = not BYOK unless on dedicated/private.
Maria (CSM): Acme prefers AWS KMS. they also asked about multi-region replication of embeddings and whether hosted supports cross-region copies.
Ajay (Security Eng): draft wording i propose:
```
Hosted: Derivative embeddings generated via the Redwood hosted API are stored in our managed object store (S3). Data is encrypted at rest (AES-256). For enterprise customers we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) using AWS KMS. Cross-region replication is available for Dedicated/Private deployments; hosted replication is limited to region of deployment.
```
Ajay (Security Eng): i can refine if legal needs more precise claims.
Priya (Solutions Eng): for SOC2 bundle i'll include: System Description (PDF), Control Matrix (xlsx), Change Management logs (csv), Incident Response runbook (pdf), Access Review exports (csv). anything else?
Lauren (AE): please also include the billing/account contact + audit date range (they asked if our audit covers 2024).
Maria (CSM): audit window = 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31 (SOC2 Type II). i'll confirm with compliance but that's standard.
onboard-bot: Reminder: upload artifacts to /s3/onboarding-evidence/acme-3741 by 2026-04-01 or status will be flagged 'at-risk' :warning:
Priya (Solutions Eng): starting upload of initial bundle now. i'll mark checklist items in the shared doc and attach links.
Ajay (Security Eng): i'll drop a final KMS Q&A snippet tomorrow morning with short bullets legal can copy/paste.
Maria (CSM): plan: priya uploads eod thu, ajay finalizes KMS wording by fri am, lauren drafts 1-pager once wording is in. i'll reply to the customer thursday afternoon with the consolidated packet. @priya @ajay @lauren :thumbsup:
Priya (Solutions Eng): ack
Ajay (Security Eng): ack
Lauren (AE): ack
Maria (CSM): thanks all. i'll keep thread updated if legal asks for edits or follow-ups from Acme.
